$comment: Text pool for the General prayer category.
requests: An unspoken request tonight. God knows the details.
Praying for a safe drive down to Tucson this weekend.
Job interview Thursday morning. Any prayers appreciated!
My son starts kindergarten Monday. Pray for us both!
Safe travels for my parents, who fly home tomorrow.
Praise report! We closed on our house today.
Peace for my heart about a big decision at work.
For my neighbor, who just lost her job this week.
Wisdom as we look at schools for next year, please.
Our dog has surgery Friday. Small prayer, big love.
Thankful for a good report at the doctor today!
Unspoken. I just really need prayer this week.
My coworker's wife is expecting twins. Pray for a healthy delivery!
Just grateful. God has been so good to us lately.
Finals week for my daughter. Focus and calm, Lord.
Pray for my brother to find his way back to God.
Rest, please. I have not slept well in a month.
Our grandson was born last night! Healthy and loud.
Starting a new job Monday. Nervous and excited.
A friend's court date is Tuesday. Peace for her.
Help me be patient with my teenagers this week.
Moving across town Saturday. Strong backs and cool weather!
Need direction on something big. God knows the rest.
My mom has a checkup next week. Hoping for good news.
Please pray for my daughter as she takes her driving test on Friday. She has practiced so hard and gets very nervous. We want her to stay calm and safe, whatever the result.
I have a final interview next week for a job I really want. It would mean less time on the road and more time with my kids. Praying for God's will, even if the answer is no.
Our family is moving to Phoenix from back in Ohio at the end of the month. Pray for safe travel, a smooth move, and that the kids make friends quickly at their new school.
My husband has been out of work for three months. He is discouraged and starting to doubt himself. Pray that the right door opens soon and that he knows he is loved no matter what.
Asking for prayer for a coworker who just found out she needs more tests on her heart. She is scared and does not have much family nearby. I want to be a good friend to her right now.
We found out we are expecting our second baby! We are thrilled and a little overwhelmed. Pray for a healthy pregnancy and for our toddler as he gets used to being a big brother.
Thank you, church family, for praying about our home sale. We got an offer this week! Keep praying that the inspection goes well and that closing stays on schedule.
Lord, give me wisdom. I have been offered a promotion, but it means more travel and less time at home. I want to make the choice that honors You and my family.
My son leaves for basic training in two weeks. I am proud of him and also trying not to cry every time I look at him. Pray for his safety, his faith, and my heart as a mom.
Our neighbor across the street lives alone and has had a hard time since his wife passed. Pray that we would know how to reach out, and that he would feel less alone.
I am going back to school at 42 to finish my degree. Pray for focus, energy, and good time management. Some nights I wonder what I was thinking!
Requesting prayer for my sister, who is going through a hard season in her marriage. She has not asked for advice, just for someone to pray. So I am asking you to join me.
My grandson has a big test at school next week. He gets anxious and freezes up. Pray that he remembers what he knows and feels calm.
We have a custody hearing coming up next month. Pray for wisdom for the judge, for peace in our home, and that our kids would feel safe and loved through all of it.
Praise report: after almost a year of looking, I accepted a job offer today! God was faithful the whole time, even when I was not. Thank you to everyone who prayed.
My best friend from college has drifted far from God. We still talk every week, and I can tell she is searching. Pray that God draws her back and gives me the right words.
Our cat needs dental surgery and she is getting older. I know it is small, but she is part of our family. Pray that she does well with the anesthesia.
Heading to the doctor next week for some routine bloodwork I have put off too long. Pray for good results and for me to take better care of myself going forward.
For safety for my husband, who drives a long commute across the valley every day. The traffic has been awful and there have been a lot of accidents lately.
Our twins start middle school this fall at different schools for the first time. Pray that they each find good friends and still stay close to each other.
God knows the details on this one. It is an unspoken request, but it weighs on me every day. Thank you for praying.
My dad turns 80 next month and still lives on his own. Pray for wisdom as we talk with him about what comes next. We want to honor him and keep him safe.
We are trying to sell our house, and it has been on the market for four months. Pray that the right buyer comes along and that we trust God's timing.
Please pray for my coworker's son, who was in a car accident this weekend. He is going to be okay, but the family is shaken up and the next few weeks will be hard.
I have a big presentation at work on Tuesday in front of the leadership team. Pray that I am prepared, clear, and do not let my nerves get the best of me.
Thanking God today for 25 years of marriage. It has not always been easy, but He has been faithful through every season. Praying for 25 more!
My niece is starting college out of state and has never lived away from home. Pray that she finds a good church and good friends, and that she is not lonely.
Pray for our small group. Several families are dealing with hard things at the same time, and we want to love each other well and not burn out.
Asking for wisdom on whether to move my mom into assisted living or have her live with us. Both options are hard. I want to do what is best for her.
My wife is due in three weeks with our first baby. Pray for a safe delivery, a healthy baby, and for me to be the dad and husband they need.
Would you pray for my daughter's first week at a new school? She is shy and it takes her a while to warm up to people. I just want her to find one good friend.
Our son is applying to colleges and the waiting is hard on all of us. Pray that he lands where God wants him and that he trusts God with the answer.
A good friend of mine just found out her job is being cut at the end of the year. She is a single mom of three. Pray for provision and a new opportunity soon.
Lifting up my brother-in-law, who has a knee procedure next Thursday. It is outpatient and routine, but he is nervous. Pray for skilled hands and a quick recovery.
We are taking a road trip to see family in Colorado next week. Pray for safe roads, a reliable car, and good time together with grandparents the kids rarely see.
I need prayer for my attitude at work. I have a new manager, and we are not getting along. Pray that I would be humble, kind, and do my job well anyway.
Thank you, Lord, for bringing our foster daughter into our home this month. Pray that she feels safe and loved, and that we have wisdom for each day.
My mother-in-law is coming to live with us for a while. Pray for patience, good communication, and lots of grace for everyone under one roof.
Pray for my coworker who lost his father last week. He came back to work too soon, I think. I want to be a good support without being pushy.
Heavenly Father, I lift up my son, who has been struggling to keep his grades up this semester. Give him focus, motivation, and good teachers who believe in him.
We have been trying to start a family for a while now. Pray for patience, hope, and that our marriage stays strong while we wait.
My husband and I are thinking about starting a business. Pray for wisdom, clear direction, and that we do not get ahead of God on this.
I would appreciate prayer for my neighbor's little boy, who is having tubes put in his ears next week. His mom is a wreck about it. Pray for peace for her too.
For our daughter and her husband, who are buying their first home. The market is tough and they keep getting outbid. Pray for the right house at the right time.
Praying for a friend who has walked away from church after being hurt. She still believes but does not trust people right now. Pray for healing and a safe place to land.
Please lift up my son, who just got his driver's license. I know he is a careful driver, but I still worry every time he leaves. Pray for his safety and my peace.
I am taking the bar exam in two weeks. I have studied for months, and now I need peace, a clear mind, and a good night's sleep before the test.
Our church friends just welcomed a new baby girl. Pray for rest for the parents, easy feedings, and health for the whole family.
Ask God to give me courage to have a hard conversation with a family member this weekend. I want to speak the truth in love and keep the relationship.
My coworker is pregnant after years of waiting and is in her first trimester. Pray for a healthy baby and for her to have peace instead of worry.
I start nursing school next month. I am excited but scared about the workload. Pray that I would have strength, good classmates, and time for my family.
This summer heat is wearing on my elderly neighbors. Their AC went out twice last month. Pray for their health and that the repair holds this time.
Pray for our family as we make a big decision about where to live. We are torn between staying near family and taking a job in another state.
My granddaughter is getting married next month. Pray that their marriage would be built on Christ and that the wedding day goes smoothly.
I have a court date next week about a small claims issue with a contractor. Pray for honesty on both sides and a fair outcome.
We are grateful for a safe trip back from visiting family. Over 2,000 miles and not a single problem with the car. God is good!
Lifting up a friend at work who has a big decision about her future. She does not know the Lord yet, but she asked me to pray. That felt like a door opening.
My daughter is moving into her first apartment. Pray for good roommates, wise money choices, and for her to stay connected to a church.
Pray that I would find a church small group where I fit. I moved here a year ago and still do not really know anyone.
My son has an audition for the school musical on Wednesday. He has worked so hard on his song. Pray that he does his best and handles the result well.
Our pastor asked us to pray for our city, so I am praying for the Phoenix area. Pray for peace in our neighborhoods and for churches to love their neighbors well.
I am grateful today. After a long, hard year, things are finally settling down. Thank you for praying for our family through all of it.
A friend from church had to put down her dog this week. It was her companion for 14 years. Pray for comfort for her heart.
We just got the news that my husband's company is relocating. We need wisdom about whether to move with them or look for something new here.
Please be in prayer for my best friend, who is going through a divorce she did not want. She is hurting and angry. Pray for her heart and for her kids.
Our youngest leaves for college this fall and the house is going to be so quiet. Pray for us as we learn this new season as empty nesters.
Guidance needed. I have two job offers and both seem good. Pray that I would choose well and not second guess myself afterward.
Pray that I would be a better listener to my wife and kids. I have been distracted and short-tempered, and they deserve better from me.
Asking prayer for my uncle, who has been far from God for most of his life. He is getting older and has started asking questions. Pray that his heart stays open.
I have a follow-up appointment with a specialist on Monday. It is probably nothing, but I would love prayer for good news and peace while I wait.
Our home is under contract, and the buyers' loan is taking longer than expected. Pray that everything comes through so we can move on schedule.
Our oldest is starting high school, and I am more nervous than she is! Pray that she makes wise choices and finds friends who build her up.
Our team at work is facing layoffs next month. Pray for everyone who is worried, and for me to be a calm and kind presence in the office.
Pray for a family on our street whose house had a small fire. Everyone is safe, but they will be out of their home for a while.
My son just started his first job. He is 16 and it is a big step. Pray that he works hard, learns a lot, and is treated well by his boss.
I am trying to quit a habit that has had a hold on me for years. Pray for strength and for me to remember that God's grace is bigger than my failures.
My parents are celebrating 50 years of marriage this fall. Praise God for their faithfulness! Pray that the family gathering is full of joy and peace.
We are flying overseas for a family wedding next month. Pray for safe flights, healthy kids on the trip, and a joyful time together.
Lifting up my daughter, who just had her first baby. She is exhausted and doubting herself. Pray that she knows she is doing a great job.
Praying for clarity. I feel God may be calling me to serve in a new way, but I am not sure where. Pray that I would be listening.
Our church friends are adopting a little boy, and the paperwork has dragged on for over a year. Pray that everything finally comes together.
Please keep my husband in your prayers as he studies for a certification exam. Passing it would open up a lot of doors for our family.
My coworker shared that her teenage son has stopped talking to her. Pray for that relationship to heal and for her to have hope.
We are hosting a family reunion this summer, and there is some tension between relatives. Pray for grace, humility, and a peaceful weekend.
Prayers for my son as he starts his first year of college. Pray that he grows in his faith and finds a good church nearby.
God has been so faithful to me this year. I want to say thank you publicly. Praise Him for answered prayers and for a church that cares.
Pray for my friend who is due with her third baby next month. Her other pregnancies were hard, and she is trying not to worry.
My dad is having cataract surgery next week. It is common and quick, but he is nervous. Pray for a smooth procedure and clear vision!
My best friend is getting baptized on Sunday! We have been praying for her for years. Praise God!
My neighbor has been so kind to our family. She does not go to church but has started asking about it. Pray that I would be a good friend and a good witness.
I am preparing for a job interview at a company I have wanted to work for since college. Pray for confidence, clear answers, and that God's will is done.
Our granddaughter just took her first steps! Thanking God for every little milestone. Pray for her health as she keeps growing.
My coworker's husband was deployed last week. She is holding down the house with three kids. Pray for strength for her and safety for him.
Prayer for our family car, which keeps breaking down. We cannot afford a new one right now. Pray for a good mechanic and a fair price.
Pray for my nephew, who is struggling to find his purpose after high school. He is a good kid, just a little lost right now.
I have been asked to lead a Bible study for the first time. Pray that I would rely on God and not on my own understanding.
Praise report. My son, who has not been to church in years, came with us on Sunday. We are so grateful and want to keep praying for him.
Pray that we would be good stewards of what God has given us. We are working on a budget for the first time, and it is humbling.
My friend from work has a court date next month to finalize her custody arrangement. Pray for peace, fairness, and what is best for her kids.
I would love prayer for my health as I start a new exercise routine. I want to be around for my grandkids for a long time.
Our church family has been such a blessing to us since our move. Pray that we would find ways to give back and serve others well.
This is a little embarrassing, but I have been lonely lately. Pray that God would bring a few good friends into my life.
I am about to retire after 32 years at the same company. It is exciting and scary. Pray that I find purpose in this next chapter and do not just sit around!
Pray for my daughter's teacher, who has been so good to her this year. She is going through some personal hard things and could use encouragement.
I am asking for wisdom with my finances. We have some unexpected bills this month, and I want to handle them wisely and without fear.
Our foster care license was just approved! Pray for the child who will come into our home, and for us to be ready for whatever comes.
Pray for my sister, who is due in a few weeks. She has been on bed rest and is going a little stir crazy. Pray for a healthy baby and a patient mama!
Thank you for praying. My mom's doctor appointment went well, and she does not need any more tests. Praise God for good news!
We are adjusting to a new schedule since my husband started working nights. Pray for rest for him and for our family to stay connected.
Remember our kids in your prayers as school starts. Pray for kind teachers, safe campuses, and good friends for all three of them.
My grandfather is turning 95! Pray for his health and that we can all gather to celebrate him while we can.
Pray for wisdom as I mentor a young man at work. He has a rough background and is trying to turn his life around. I want to point him to Jesus.

There is so much going on in our family right now that I do not even know where to start. I am not sure how to put it into words, so I am just asking you to pray. God knows every detail, and I trust Him with it. Some days I feel strong, and other days I feel like I am barely hanging on. Thank you for standing with us in prayer.

My son is a senior in high school and has been offered a scholarship to play baseball at a school four states away. We are proud of him, but we are also nervous about him being so far from home. Pray that he makes a wise choice, that he stays grounded in his faith, and that we can trust God as we let him go. This has been our dream for him, and it still feels hard.

I have been out of work for almost six months now. I have sent out more applications than I can count and had a few interviews that did not go anywhere. Our savings are getting low, and I am starting to feel ashamed even though I know I should not. Pray for a job, but also pray for my heart. I want to trust God and not lose hope while I wait for the next door to open.

We just found out that we are expecting a baby, which is a big surprise since our youngest is already 10. We are excited, but also a little shocked, and we are trying to figure out what this means for our home, our jobs, and our finances. Pray for a healthy pregnancy, for wisdom as we plan, and for our older kids as they get used to the news.

My husband and I have been praying about whether to sell our house and move closer to our grandkids in Texas. We love our church and our friends here in the valley, and the thought of leaving is hard. But we also want to be part of our grandkids' lives while they are young. Pray for clear direction, unity in our marriage, and peace whatever we decide.

I want to share a praise report. Last year I asked for prayer for my son, who had walked away from God and from our family. This month he called me out of the blue and asked if he could come to church with us. He has been back three Sundays in a row now. I am so thankful for everyone who prayed. God really does hear us, and I will never stop praising Him for this.

My best friend lives across the country, and she is going through a really hard season. Her marriage is struggling, her job is stressful, and she is caring for her aging parents. I wish I could be there in person, but all I can do is call and pray. Please join me in praying for strength, rest, and hope for her. I want her to know she is not alone.

I have a big decision coming up at work. I have been offered a chance to lead a new team, but it would mean longer hours and less time with my family. My kids are still young, and I do not want to miss these years. I also feel like this could be an open door from God. Pray that I would hear His voice clearly and make the choice that honors Him.

Our neighbors moved in about a year ago, and we have slowly become friends. They have never been to church, and the husband has made it clear he does not believe in God. Lately the wife has been asking me questions about faith and prayer. Pray that I would be patient, honest, and loving, and that God would keep softening both of their hearts.

This summer has been hard. The heat has been brutal, our AC went out twice, and my husband's hours were cut at work. We are not in a crisis, but it feels like one thing after another. I know God is faithful, and I am trying to stay thankful. Pray for provision, patience, and for us to remember all the ways He has already taken care of us.

I want to ask for prayer for my coworker. She has been with our company for 20 years, and she was just told her position is being eliminated. She is a single mom with a son in college, and she is scared about what comes next. I do not know if she has a faith of her own, but she let me pray with her today. Pray that God provides and that she sees His love in this.

My daughter is starting kindergarten this fall, and I am having a harder time with it than she is. She is so excited to ride the bus and make new friends. I keep worrying about everything that could go wrong. Pray that she has a kind teacher and a safe year, and pray for me to trust God with her instead of holding on so tight.

I am asking for prayer for my dad, who has been far from God for as long as I can remember. He is in his seventies now, and his health is starting to slow him down. He has started asking me questions about church and about what I believe. I do not want to push too hard, but I do not want to miss this window either. Pray for wisdom and for his heart.

Next month my husband and I will celebrate 10 years of marriage. We have been through a lot together, including two moves, a job loss, and the birth of our three kids. Some years were harder than others, but God has carried us through every one. We are so thankful. Pray that the next 10 years are full of joy, growth, and a deeper love for each other and for Jesus.

My son has a big exam next week that will decide whether he gets into the program he has been working toward for two years. He has studied hard, but he struggles with test anxiety and sometimes his mind goes blank. Pray that he goes in feeling calm and prepared, that he remembers what he knows, and that he trusts God with the result either way.

I am a new believer and I am still learning how all of this works. I was baptized last month, and it has been amazing, but it has also been hard. Some of my old friends do not understand, and my family thinks it is a phase. Pray that I would grow in my faith, find good Christian friends, and be a light to the people I love without pushing them away.

Our family is going on a mission trip to Mexico next month with a group from church. This is the first time our kids will be on a trip like this, and we are excited to serve together. Pray for safe travel, good health for the whole team, and that we would be a blessing to the families we meet. Pray also that God would use this trip to grow our kids' faith.

I have been caring for my mother for the past two years, and I am worn out. I love her dearly, and I am glad I can be there for her, but some days I feel like I have nothing left to give. My siblings live out of state and cannot help much. Pray for strength, rest, and wisdom about whether it is time to look for more help. I do not want to fail her.

Please pray for our pet, a sweet old dog who has been part of our family for 13 years. He has to have surgery next week to remove a growth, and the vet says he should be fine, but at his age there is always some risk. Our kids are really worried. Pray that the surgery goes well and that he gets a few more good years with us.

I am starting a new job on Monday after being at my last company for 15 years. I am excited about the change, but I am nervous about learning everything new and fitting in with a new team. Pray that I would make a good first impression, learn quickly, and find ways to show God's love to my new coworkers. Pray also for my family as we adjust to a new schedule.

My daughter and her husband are expecting their first baby in a few weeks, and we are so excited to become grandparents. They live about an hour away, so we hope to help out as much as we can. Pray for a safe and healthy delivery, for rest for the new parents, and for wisdom for us as we learn how to be good grandparents without overstepping.

My friend from our small group just found out she has to have a minor surgery next month. It is not serious, but she is a single mom with two little ones and no family nearby. Our group is setting up meals and childcare, and we want to love her well. Pray for her recovery, for her kids, and for our group to serve her with joy.

I am facing a hard conversation with my boss next week. I feel like I have been treated unfairly in some decisions at work, and I need to bring it up in a respectful way. I do not want to come across as angry or bitter. Pray that I would speak with grace and honesty, that my boss would listen with an open heart, and that God would be honored in how I handle this.

This is an unspoken request. There is something going on that I am not ready to share, even with close friends. It is weighing on me heavily, and I am asking for prayer for peace, wisdom, and a clear path forward. God knows all of the details, and I trust Him. Thank you for praying without needing to know more.
details: We would really appreciate your prayers this week, church family.
It has been a heavy few weeks, and I am feeling it.
Thank you for taking the time to pray. It means more than you know.
I know God is in control, but my heart needs reminding some days.
We are trying to trust God with every part of this.
Some days are easier than others. Today is a harder one.
I would love for a few people to remember this throughout the week.
Our family has been praying about this for a while now.
I keep reminding myself that God has been faithful before, and He will be again.
I am trying not to worry, but it has been on my mind a lot.
It is a small thing to some people, but it is big to us.
We are thankful for a church family that prays for each other.
I do not always know what to pray, so I am grateful for others who will.
This has been on my heart for a long time, and I finally decided to share it.
Pray for peace in the waiting. That is the hardest part for me.
It feels good just to write it down and know others are praying too.
We are holding on to hope and to God's promises right now.
Sleep has been hard to come by lately, so pray for rest as well.
I will post an update when we know more. Thank you for caring.
Pray that we would see God's hand in this, whatever the outcome.
We know God hears us, and we are leaning on Him more than ever.
It has been a long season for our family, and we are tired.
Any prayers for wisdom and peace would be a gift right now.
I am grateful for every person who has already checked in with us.
"God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble." (Psalm 46:1, WEB) I am holding on to that one.
answers: God came through in a way we didn't expect. Thank you for praying!
Thank you all for praying. Things worked out better than we hoped.
Praise God! This prayer has been answered. We are so grateful.
Still waiting on the final answer, but I have peace about it now.
Not everything is settled yet, but we can see God moving. Thank you for standing with us.
Answered! God was faithful once again. Thank you, church family.
We are on the other side of this now, and God carried us through every step.
Part of this has been answered, and we are still praying about the rest. Thank you for not giving up on us.
The answer was not what I expected, but I can see now that it was best. God knew.
Thank you for every prayer. We felt them, and God answered.
Nothing has changed yet, but my heart has. I am trusting God with the timing.
Update: things are moving in the right direction. Please keep praying!
God answered this one in His own way and His own time. So thankful.
Wanted to let you know this prayer was answered. God is good!
We are still in the middle of it, but there is so much more peace in our home now.
What a relief. It all came together, and we know it was God. Thank you!
God has been so kind to us through all of this. Thank you for praying.
This turned out well. I am grateful for each person who prayed.
Small steps forward every week. Thank you for continuing to pray.
Still waiting, still trusting. Thank you for walking with us.
The door we prayed for opened! We are amazed and thankful.
Things are better than they were. Not perfect, but better. Thank you!
God answered with a clear yes. We are praising Him today.
The answer was a no, but God has given us peace and a new direction.
Thank you, prayer team. This one is resolved, and we are so thankful.
God provided right when we needed it most. Your prayers mattered.
Some of this is answered and some is still in progress. Grateful for every prayer.
It went smoothly. Praise God, and thank you all!
I don't have the full answer yet, but I am not anxious about it anymore.
Happy to report that God worked it all out. Thank you for praying with us!
